note: Week 10 manager roasts from the Sunday afternoon board. The point fields match schedule.week10 so the cards stay attached. The copy is about the manager, and it does not repeat the score.

matchups.headline: Jahmyr vs Sandusky
matchups.roast:
Jahmyr, the whole bit is Gibbs, and for once the bit showed up. His day is over. You still get to sit there and watch Sandusky deal with it.
Sandusky, you started Jefferson, Taylor, and Cook. That was the plan. They have spent the afternoon losing to one running back whose game already ended. Burrow tonight is you asking the night game to cover for a bad roster.
matchups.tag: Jahmyr's whole bit is Gibbs, and Gibbs is already done.

matchups.headline: Kyle vs Kabul FC
matchups.roast:
Kyle, you are in first, and you still sat Jayden Daniels. His game ended Thursday. You went with Lawrence. You will probably survive it. That is the part that should bother you.
Kabul FC, you are only hanging around because Kyle did that. Your own quarterback has not played. Enjoy the scoreboard while it is lying to you.
matchups.tag: Kyle sat the quarterback whose game ended Thursday.

matchups.headline: Smert vs Easy Peasy
matchups.roast:
Smert, you are in last, and you started a running back who is Out. The defense you grabbed this morning is the best thing on your roster. Dak and CeeDee have not played, so you still have a rescue plan. The lineup you locked in did not deserve one.
Easy Peasy, you left Diggs on the bench. His Thursday game is over, and he was better than the receivers you trusted. You won the lineup argument against yourself.
matchups.tag: Smert started a running back who is Out.

matchups.headline: Gerrit vs All Heart
matchups.roast:
Gerrit, you built the week around Drake Maye. His game is over, and he spent it watching a blowout. Thursday already did your job. You are winning because Likely and Skattebo showed up, not because you did.
All Heart, Mahomes did his part. You filled the rest of the lineup with guys who have been invisible, and you are the one getting walked. CMC has not even played yet, so this is the roster you chose to fall behind with.
matchups.tag: Gerrit is winning without the quarterback he built the week around.

matchups.headline: Chewy vs Dimes
matchups.roast:
Dimes, you sat Goff for Bryce Young. Goff is done. Young is stuck in a rock fight. You picked the wrong quarterback, and the one you benched cannot bail you out anymore.
Chewy, you are mostly just watching Dimes do this to himself. The one sharp thing you did was throw the Vikings defense in.
matchups.tag: Dimes sat the quarterback whose game is already over.
